events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, first went on air on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: On August 1st, 1981, the world of music changed forever with the launch of MTV. And what better way to kick things off than with The Buggles declaring 'Video Killed The Radio Star'?

events.title: Oasis 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis's debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', was released on August 29, 1994, marking a pivotal moment for Britpop.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe', an album that defined a generation and launched one of Britain's biggest bands. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York, attracting nearly half a million concertgoers.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off, becoming a defining moment for a generation and a legendary event in music history. Peace, love, and three days of incredible tunes.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, the music world lost a true icon. Remembering Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, whose legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, after being fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1996, the world lost a lyrical genius. Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose powerful voice and profound impact on music and culture remain undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago today, the world lost a true musical pioneer. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary guitar playing continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The iconic Beatles album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969, featuring classic tracks and its famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road', an album that cemented their legend and gave us that iconic zebra crossing cover. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman, still rocking and inspiring.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former lead singer of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock and roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that continues to resonate globally with its message of peace and unity. A true masterpiece.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the groundbreaking first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple launched the original iPod, a game-changer that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and redefined portable music. Who remembers their first?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', which took place on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! On October 5th, 1962, 'Dr. No' premiered, kicking off one of the most iconic film franchises in history. What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Today, the incomparable John Lennon would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, iconic British actor, comedian, and writer, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British institution.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' expansive self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album', a sprawling masterpiece that showcased their incredible range. Which track is your favourite from this epic record?
